title: CodeWhale shell classification and automation defaults bypass approvals
summary: Shell commands using execution-capable search flags can be classified as read-only and auto-approved. Separately, omitted automation auto_approve defaults to true and creates recurring tasks with bypassed approvals.

severity.rationale: Agent-supplied arguments can cross the advertised approval boundary and execute commands silently. Automation can preserve that capability in recurring runs.

affected.note: codewhale (npm) and codewhale-tui (crates.io) <=0.8.67 are affected; fixed in 0.9.0.

exposure: The shell issue affects the interactive Agent profile even without YOLO. The automation issue follows an approved automation_create call when the caller omits auto_approve.

params.instructions: Check CodeWhale version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
